SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization enrollment ON enrollment.student_id = student.id AND enrollment.relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' AND enrollment.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN sys_organization enrollment_org ON enrollment_org.id = enrollment.organization_id AND enrollment_org.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_org.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student.id = #{studentId} AND enrollment.organization_id = #{organizationId}
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND organization_id = #{organizationId} AND relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT')

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization student_organization JOIN sys_organization related_organization ON related_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND related_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND related_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.organization_id = student_organization.organization_id WHERE student_organization.student_id = #{studentId} AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND organization_admin.user_id = #{userId})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization student_organization JOIN sys_organization organization ON organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student_organization.student_id = #{studentId} AND student_organization.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_student_organization (id, student_id, organization_id, relation_type, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{studentId}, #{organizationId}, 'ENROLLMENT', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization student_organization JOIN sys_organization enrollment_organization ON enrollment_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND enrollment_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = #{classOrganizationId} AND class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student_organization.student_id = #{studentId} AND student_organization.relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND class_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(enrollment_organization.organization_path, '%'))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization student_organization ON student_organization.student_id = student.id JOIN sys_organization related_organization ON related_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND related_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND related_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization target_organization ON target_organization.id = #{organizationId} AND target_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND target_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student.id = #{studentId} AND student.status = 'ENABLED' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND related_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(target_organization.organization_path, '%'))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization student_organization ON student_organization.student_id = student.id JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student.id = #{studentId} AND student.status = 'ENABLED' AND student_organization.organization_id = #{classOrganizationId} AND student_organization.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE')

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization student_organization ON student_organization.student_id = student.id JOIN edu_teacher_class teacher_class ON teacher_class.class_organization_id = student_organization.organization_id JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student.id = #{studentId} AND student.status = 'ENABLED' AND student_organization.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND teacher_class.teacher_user_id = #{teacherUserId} AND teacher_class.status = 'ACTIVE')

SELECT DISTINCT student.id FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization student_organization ON student_organization.student_id = student.id JOIN sys_organization related_organization ON related_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND related_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND related_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization target_organization ON target_organization.id = #{organizationId} AND target_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND target_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND related_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(target_organization.organization_path, '%') ORDER BY student.id

SELECT DISTINCT student.id AS student_id, student.student_name, student.grade_code, student.status AS student_status, academic.student_number AS student_number, enrollment.organization_id AS enrollment_organization_id, enrollment_organization.organization_name AS enrollment_organization_name, student_class.organization_id AS current_class_organization_id, class_organization.organization_name AS current_class_organization_name FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization enrollment ON enrollment.student_id = student.id AND enrollment.relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' AND enrollment.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN edu_student_enrollment_metadata academic ON academic.student_id=student.id AND academic.institution_organization_id=enrollment.organization_id JOIN sys_organization enrollment_organization ON enrollment_organization.id = enrollment.organization_id JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.user_id = #{userId} JOIN sys_organization managed_organization ON managed_organization.id = organization_admin.organization_id AND managed_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND managed_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' LEFT JOIN edu_student_organization student_class ON student_class.student_id = student.id AND student_class.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND student_class.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization member_class WHERE member_class.id = student_class.organization_id AND member_class.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(enrollment_organization.organization_path, '%')) LEFT JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = student_class.organization_id WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(managed_organization.organization_path, '%') ORDER BY student.student_name, student.id

SELECT DISTINCT class_organization.id, class_organization.organization_name AS name FROM sys_organization class_organization JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.user_id = #{userId} JOIN sys_organization managed_organization ON managed_organization.id = organization_admin.organization_id AND managed_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND managed_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE class_organization.organization_type = 'CLASS' AND class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(managed_organization.organization_path, '%') ORDER BY class_organization.organization_name, class_organization.id
SELECT organization_id FROM edu_student_organization WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND relation_type = 'CLASS' AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY organization_id
SELECT organization_id FROM edu_student_organization WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY effective_from, id
SELECT organization_id FROM edu_student_organization WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT student_organization.organization_id FROM edu_student_organization student_organization JOIN sys_organization enrollment_organization ON enrollment_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND enrollment_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = #{classOrganizationId} AND class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student_organization.student_id = #{studentId} AND student_organization.relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND class_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(enrollment_organization.organization_path, '%') ORDER BY student_organization.effective_from, student_organization.id

SELECT student_class.organization_id FROM edu_student_organization student_class JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = student_class.organization_id JOIN sys_organization enrollment_organization ON enrollment_organization.id = #{enrollmentOrganizationId} WHERE student_class.student_id = #{studentId} AND student_class.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND student_class.status = 'ACTIVE' AND class_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(enrollment_organization.organization_path, '%') ORDER BY student_class.effective_from, student_class.id

mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT student.id AS student_id, student.student_name, student.grade_code, student.status AS student_status, academic.student_number AS student_number, enrollment.organization_id AS enrollment_organization_id, enrollment_organization.organization_name AS enrollment_organization_name, student_class.organization_id AS current_class_organization_id, class_organization.organization_name AS current_class_organization_name FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization enrollment ON enrollment.student_id = student.id AND enrollment.relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' AND enrollment.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN edu_student_enrollment_metadata academic ON academic.student_id=student.id AND academic.institution_organization_id=enrollment.organization_id JOIN sys_organization enrollment_organization ON enrollment_organization.id = enrollment.organization_id LEFT JOIN edu_student_organization student_class ON student_class.student_id = student.id AND student_class.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND student_class.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization member_class WHERE member_class.id = student_class.organization_id AND member_class.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(enrollment_organization.organization_path, '%')
AND member_class.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(#{path},'%')1=0 ) LEFT JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = student_class.organization_id WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED'
ORDER BY student.student_name, student.id

AND
class_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(#{path}, '%')
1 = 0

SELECT DISTINCT student.id, student.student_name, NULL AS student_account_masked, visible_class.id AS current_class_id, visible_class.organization_name AS current_class_name, NULL AS relationship_role FROM edu_student student JOIN sys_organization target_class ON target_class.id = #{classId} JOIN sys_organization target_institution ON target_institution.organization_type IN ('SCHOOL','TRAINING_INSTITUTION') AND target_class.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(target_institution.organization_path, '%') LEFT JOIN edu_student_organization current_relation ON current_relation.student_id = student.id AND current_relation.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND current_relation.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization member_class WHERE member_class.id=current_relation.organization_id AND member_class.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(target_institution.organization_path,'%') AND (target_institution.organization_type='SCHOOL' OR member_class.id=#{classId})) LEFT JOIN sys_organization visible_class ON visible_class.id = current_relation.organization_id
AND visible_class.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(#{path}, '%') 1 = 0
WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED'
AND current_relation.organization_id = #{classId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization enrollment JOIN sys_organization enrollment_org ON enrollment_org.id = enrollment.organization_id WHERE enrollment.student_id = student.id AND enrollment.relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' AND enrollment.status = 'ACTIVE' AND enrollment_org.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_org.effective_status = 'ENABLED' AND LEFT(target_class.organization_path, CHAR_LENGTH(enrollment_org.organization_path)) = enrollment_org.organization_path
)
ORDER BY student.student_name, student.id

family.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(#{path},'%') 1=0))
mapper.update: UPDATE edu_student_organization SET status='INACTIVE',effective_to=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND organization_id=#{classOrganizationId} AND relation_type='CLASS' AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_user_organization WHERE user_id=#{studentUserId} AND organization_id IN ( SELECT member_org.id FROM sys_organization member_org JOIN sys_organization institution ON institution.id=#{institutionId} WHERE member_org.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(institution.organization_path,'%') AND member_org.organization_type IN('SCHOOL','TRAINING_INSTITUTION','CAMPUS','GRADE','CLASS'))
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student s JOIN sys_user_organization member ON member.user_id=s.student_user_id JOIN sys_organization family ON family.id=member.organization_id AND family.organization_type='FAMILY' AND family.status='ENABLED' AND family.effective_status='ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization_admin admin ON admin.organization_id=family.id AND admin.user_id=#{userId} WHERE s.id=#{studentId})
